name: prompting
description: Write, optimise, or migrate a prompt for a specific model from Anthropic, Google, or OpenAI, tuned to that model's documented behaviour: Claude (Fable 5.2, Mythos 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5, Opus 4.8), Gemini (3 and 4 Carbon), and GPT (6 and 6.2). Works offline from a mirror of each vendor's prompting guides, refreshed by a bundled sync script. Returns the finished prompt, plus the request settings to change when the documented fix is not prompt text. Replaces the prompting-claude and prompt-engineering plugins. Auto-engages via the 'prompting' skill; slash-available as /prompting.
